description.value: Eggstatic Vancouver is a halal, Middle Eastern-inspired brunch restaurant in the Riley Park neighbourhood, described on its own site as the first in Vancouver to bring an artisan Middle Eastern brunch format to the city at this level of ambition. The menu centres on shakshuka, Lotus Biscoff pancakes, benedicts, and specialty lattes such as the Baklava latte. It is part of a growing Canadian chain with over a dozen locations across Ontario, Quebec, and now BC, and appears to have just completed its Vancouver grand opening.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the OSM address (3950 Main St, Vancouver, BC V5V 3P2) and phone (+1 236-429-2140), and Google reviews dated May 26–27, 2026 confirm the location is actively open, with multiple reviewers referencing a grand opening. The site mentions street parking for cars and the #3 bus but makes no reference to bike racks, bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or Wi-Fi; an 'Order Now' call-to-action supports online/takeout ordering. OSM opening hours differ from those shown on the website, suggesting the OSM record may already be slightly stale.
concerns: OSM opening_hours (Tu-Fr 09:00-16:00; Sa-Su 09:00-17:00) do not match the website (Mon-Fri 8 AM–3 PM; Sat-Sun 8 AM–4 PM); OSM data appears outdated.
Multiple reviews dated May 26–27, 2026 reference a grand opening, indicating this location has only just opened; long-term operating continuity is unconfirmed.
